thesis: BBAI ran +30.9% into a long-gamma $5 dealer pin (+$82.0M GEX, ZGL $2.64 [STRUCT:gex]) while whole-tape net call premium turned negative (-$999,867 [FLOW:insights_deep_dive]) — a price-vs-flow DIVERGENCE [INSIGHT:price-vs-flow]. With IV rich vs realized (VRP +0.28 PREMIUM_SELLING [HIST:vrp]), no catalyst until 8/10, and a TRANSITIONAL reduce-size regime [MACRO:MarketRegime], the edge is to sell premium around the $5 pin, not chase. Starter-only: 26.37% short float [SENT:short_float fz] is a live squeeze tail and the desk came back 0-of-5 long.

primary.trigger: spot holds the $5.00-5.10 GEX pin and rejects the $5.50 call wall

aggressive.trigger: intraday tag of the $5.45-5.55 call wall — leg the call-credit side

fade.trigger: daily close above $5.50 = squeeze-through — STOP the short call side, do not fight

invalidation.price: daily close > $5.50 (squeeze through the call wall) or < $4.50 (air-pocket through thin put support) breaks the $5-pin range
invalidation.signal: net_call_premium flips strongly positive with ask-side near-dated call buying (squeeze confirmed), or GEX regime turns negative [FLOW:insights_deep_dive]
invalidation.macro: hot June CPI / hawkish FOMC small-cap risk-off, OR a fresh defense-contract headline re-ignites momentum [MACRO:Fed]

structures.note: PRIMARY. Sells rich complacent IV around the $5 long-gamma pin; short strikes outside the +/-6.8% expected move; wings are squeeze-defense; close/roll before the 6/18 un-pin; max loss <= 1.0% of book.
STARTER only (p<0.50 bearish backtest + squeeze risk). Target $4.00 max-pain, ~3:1; defined-risk; max loss <= 0.5% of book.

key_risks: 26.37% short float + ~3 DTC -> squeeze through $5.50 ignites the short-call wing
6/18 OPEX un-pin removes the +$82M $5 gamma stabilizer -> range can break violently
thin put support below $4.50 -> air-pocket toward $4.00 if the pin fails
low quality (P/S 18.95, -226.7% margin, flat revenue) -> a sentiment gap is fundamentally unanchored
fresh defense-contract headline re-ignites momentum against the fade
